I'd check that number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you described a ticket #8841 as the Detention Summary export and kiosk browser-cache issue, and said you'd closed it out. The digest may have reused or mistyped the number. The Door 14 ticket may also have a different one.

I can't see any account ticket records from here, so I couldn't confirm which is right. The Hartford incident ticket, INC-4821, is a different issue at a different site. Your own support queue or Mateo's original submission should settle it.
